Asset type: full-screen portrait casual mobile puzzle game background illustration, aspect 720:1520. BACKGROUND ONLY.
Primary request: Create 锦绣朱楼 as a GRAND PALACE BANQUET HALL seen in dramatic architectural perspective, a genuinely new environment, not a framed parchment and curtain composition.
Scene and perspective: one large dark crimson CARVED ARCHWAY rises from only the LEFT foreground and curves across the upper-left corner, cropped off screen asymmetrically. View through it toward a distant sequence of tall vermilion columns and a sumptuous golden coffered ceiling in the upper third. Warm ceremonial illumination glows between pillars. A few narrow silk banners hang high at the far right periphery only. Deep spatial perspective, imposing luxurious architecture. No pair of matching lamps. No symmetrical frame.
The broad playing resting plane in the center is a lustrous pale ivory and warm-yellow polished stone inlay on an immense RED LACQUER banquet table. This table is already in foreground at y32% and extends continuously to the bottom edge in perspective, its pale ivory inlay occupies the central 70% of width; deep crimson lacquer rim and delicate gilt details remain near the far side edges. Surface is subtle, unoccupied, finely reflective, no dishes or objects in the main playing area. In the extreme lower-right corner only, a small gold ceremonial incense burner or ornate brass cup, no copper hotpot. Foreground should clearly be red lacquer with ivory polished stone and gold, not brown wood.
Lighting and rendering: bold rich crimson, dark red/black carved architectural shadows, restrained bright gold, warm celebratory candle-lit gleam. Intricate carved lacquer and gilded ceiling beams, tactile polished stone. Detailed painterly casual mobile game illustration, expressive atmospheric depth, polished visual storytelling, no photorealism, no flat vector.
Composition for later UI overlay: no actual UI; top logo space y0–10%, levelbar y10–15%, progress y15%; central food-card cluster x21–75% y34–57% needs clean low-contrast ivory surface behind it; tray y74–82%, buttons y91–96%. Any strong decorative lines stay at far edges, and the central area stays luminous and clean.
STRICT NEGATIVES: no text, letters, Chinese characters, numbers, logos, UI, buttons, food tile cards, trays, phone frame, people, watermarks. No giant rectangular blank parchment wall. No full-width fabric swag. No two symmetric lanterns. No twin vases/potted plants on pedestals. No copper hotpot in lower-left. No horizontal brown wooden table horizon at73%.
